podcast.body: As the final hit from her debut album, the video for "Lucky Star" established Madonna as a fashion icon, inspiring many "Madonna wannabes" with its lacy, naval-bearing outfit. It became her first top five hit, reaching number four. "Lucky Star eventually reached number four, Madonna's first top five hit."

podcast.body: This song reached its peak on the charts in October 1984. Its success contributed to the start of Madonna's remarkable six-year streak of 16 consecutive top five hits, a record that remains unbroken on the Hot 100. "by the time Lucky Star reached its peak in October of 84, Madonna had kicked off a six year streak of 16 consecutive top five hits, a still unbroken hot 100 record."
